plans.title: First Steps
plans.subtitle: Meet Jesus in the book of Mark
plans.about: Start here. How to walk through a chapter, then the shortest and fastest Gospel, one chapter at a time.

plans.title: The Big Picture
plans.subtitle: The whole Bible in 30 chapters
plans.about: From the first chapter of Genesis to the last chapters of Revelation: the one story every book belongs to.

plans.title: Luke
plans.subtitle: Good Tidings of Great Joy
plans.about: The whole Gospel of Luke, chapter by chapter: an orderly account of Jesus, from the angel’s good tidings to the road to Emmaus.

big-picture-00.title: The One Great Story
big-picture-00.label: The Big Picture
big-picture-00.question: Before we begin, where do you see yourself in God’s great story today?

bp-1kings-18.title: The LORD, He Is the God
bp-1kings-18.label: 1 Kings 18
bp-1kings-18.question: Elijah asked, how long halt ye between two opinions? What is competing with God for first place in your heart, that you will give up today?

bp-1samuel-17.title: The Battle Is the LORD’s
bp-1samuel-17.label: 1 Samuel 17
bp-1samuel-17.question: David remembered the lion and the bear before he faced the giant. What has God already done for you that will give you courage today?

bp-2kings-25.title: The City Was Broken Up
bp-2kings-25.label: 2 Kings 25
bp-2kings-25.question: Even after Jerusalem fell, God kept a light burning for David’s family. Where do you need to hold on to God’s faithfulness today?

bp-2samuel-07.title: Thy Throne Shall Be Established for Ever
bp-2samuel-07.label: 2 Samuel 7
bp-2samuel-07.question: David asked, who am I, that thou hast brought me hitherto? What has God brought you through, that you will thank him for today?

bp-acts-02.title: They Were All Filled with the Holy Ghost
bp-acts-02.label: Acts 2
bp-acts-02.question: The first believers continued in God’s Word, fellowship, breaking bread and prayer. Which of these will you give yourself to today?

bp-daniel-06.title: My God Hath Sent His Angel
bp-daniel-06.label: Daniel 6
bp-daniel-06.question: Daniel prayed three times a day, as he did aforetime. What daily habit of prayer will you keep, or begin, today?

bp-deuteronomy-06.title: Hear, O Israel
bp-deuteronomy-06.label: Deuteronomy 6
bp-deuteronomy-06.question: Moses said, talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way. In what ordinary moment will you speak of God today?

bp-exodus-03.title: I AM THAT I AM
bp-exodus-03.label: Exodus 3
bp-exodus-03.question: Moses asked, who am I? and God answered, I will be with thee. What task feels too big for you, that you will trust God to be with you in today?

bp-exodus-14.title: Stand Still, and See
bp-exodus-14.label: Exodus 14
bp-exodus-14.question: Moses said, fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD. What fear will you hand over to God today, and let him fight for you?

bp-exodus-20.title: I Am the LORD Thy God
bp-exodus-20.label: Exodus 20
bp-exodus-20.question: God said, I am the LORD thy God, which have brought thee out. Remembering what God has done for you, which commandment will you ask him to help you keep today?

bp-genesis-01.title: In the Beginning
bp-genesis-01.label: Genesis 1
bp-genesis-01.question: God made you in his own image. How will that change the way you see yourself, or someone else, today?

bp-genesis-03.title: Where Art Thou?
bp-genesis-03.label: Genesis 3
bp-genesis-03.question: God called, where art thou? Is there something you have been hiding from God that you will bring to him today?

bp-genesis-06.title: Noah Found Grace
bp-genesis-06.label: Genesis 6
bp-genesis-06.question: Noah did all that God commanded him, even before he saw any rain. What is one thing God has asked of you that you will do today, by faith?

bp-genesis-12.title: Get Thee Out of Thy Country
bp-genesis-12.label: Genesis 12
bp-genesis-12.question: Abram went out not knowing where he was going, only trusting the God who called him. What next step is God asking you to take today?

bp-genesis-22.title: God Will Provide Himself a Lamb
bp-genesis-22.label: Genesis 22
bp-genesis-22.question: Abraham trusted that God would provide, even when he could not see how. Where do you need to trust God to provide today?

bp-genesis-45.title: God Did Send Me Before You
bp-genesis-45.label: Genesis 45
bp-genesis-45.question: Joseph saw God’s hand even in the wrong done to him. Where in your own story do you need to trust that God means it for good?

bp-isaiah-53.title: Wounded for Our Transgressions
bp-isaiah-53.label: Isaiah 53
bp-isaiah-53.question: Isaiah says the LORD laid on him the iniquity of us all. What will you say to Jesus today, knowing that he carried your sins?

bp-jeremiah-31.title: A New Covenant
bp-jeremiah-31.label: Jeremiah 31
bp-jeremiah-31.question: God said, I have loved thee with an everlasting love. What would change today if you truly believed that God loves you like that?

bp-john-11.title: I Am the Resurrection, and the Life
bp-john-11.label: John 11
bp-john-11.question: Jesus asked Martha, believest thou this? How will you answer him today?

bp-joshua-06.title: The Wall Fell Down Flat
bp-joshua-06.label: Joshua 6
bp-joshua-06.question: God said, I have given, before the walls fell. What promise of God will you act on today, even before you see it?

bp-luke-02.title: Good Tidings of Great Joy
bp-luke-02.label: Luke 2
bp-luke-02.question: The angel said, unto you is born a Saviour. What does it mean to you today that Jesus came for you?

bp-luke-15.title: Was Lost, and Is Found
bp-luke-15.label: Luke 15
bp-luke-15.question: The father ran to his son while he was still a great way off. Which son are you most like today, and what will you do about it?

bp-luke-24.title: He Is Not Here, but Is Risen
bp-luke-24.label: Luke 24
bp-luke-24.question: The two disciples said, did not our heart burn within us? How has Jesus spoken to you through his Word on this walk?

bp-mark-15.title: Truly This Man Was the Son of God
bp-mark-15.label: Mark 15
bp-mark-15.question: Barabbas went free because Jesus took his place. What will you say to God today, knowing that Jesus took yours?

bp-matthew-05.title: Ye Are the Light of the World
bp-matthew-05.label: Matthew 5
bp-matthew-05.question: Jesus said, love your enemies and pray for them. Who is one person you find hard to love, that you will pray for today?

bp-nehemiah-02.title: Let Us Rise Up and Build
bp-nehemiah-02.label: Nehemiah 2
bp-nehemiah-02.question: Nehemiah prayed a quick prayer before he answered the king. In what moment today will you stop and pray before you speak or act?

bp-proverbs-03.title: Trust in the LORD with All Thine Heart
bp-proverbs-03.label: Proverbs 3
bp-proverbs-03.question: Proverbs says, in all thy ways acknowledge him. What part of your life will you bring to God and trust him with fully today?

bp-psalms-23.title: The LORD Is My Shepherd
bp-psalms-23.label: Psalm 23
bp-psalms-23.question: David said, the LORD is my shepherd. In what part of your life will you let him lead you today?

bp-revelation-21.title: Behold, I Make All Things New
bp-revelation-21.label: Revelation 21
bp-revelation-21.question: God says, behold, I make all things new. What would it mean for you to live today in the hope of that promise?

bp-ruth-01.title: Whither Thou Goest
bp-ruth-01.label: Ruth 1
bp-ruth-01.question: Ruth said, whither thou goest, I will go. Who is someone you will stand beside in faithful love today?

mark-00.title: Meet the Book of Mark
mark-00.label: Meet Mark
mark-00.question: If someone asked you right now who Jesus is, what would you say? Hold on to your answer, and see how it grows over these sixteen chapters.

mark-01.title: Prepare Ye the Way
mark-01.label: Mark 1
mark-01.question: Simon and Andrew left their nets straightway. What is one thing you will lay down today to follow Jesus?

mark-02.title: Thy Sins Be Forgiven Thee
mark-02.label: Mark 2
mark-02.question: The four friends would not give up until they brought their friend to Jesus. Who is one person you will carry to Jesus in prayer today?

mark-03.title: Whosoever Shall Do the Will of God
mark-03.label: Mark 3
mark-03.question: Jesus chose the twelve first of all to be with him. When will you take time today simply to be with Jesus?

mark-04.title: Peace, Be Still
mark-04.label: Mark 4
mark-04.question: Which worry is choking God’s Word in your heart, and what will you do to pull it out today?

mark-05.title: Be Not Afraid, Only Believe
mark-05.label: Mark 5
mark-05.question: Jesus told the man to go home and tell how great things the Lord had done for him. Who will you tell today about something God has done for you?

mark-06.title: Be of Good Cheer: It Is I
mark-06.label: Mark 6
mark-06.question: Jesus said to his tired friends, come apart and rest a while. Where will you find a quiet moment with him today?

mark-07.title: He Hath Done All Things Well
mark-07.label: Mark 7
mark-07.question: Jesus said that evil comes from within, out of the heart. What is one thing in your heart that you will bring to God and ask him to make clean today?

mark-08.title: Whom Say Ye That I Am?
mark-08.label: Mark 8
mark-08.question: Jesus asked, but whom say ye that I am? What is your own answer today, in your own words?

mark-09.title: Lord, I Believe; Help Thou Mine Unbelief
mark-09.label: Mark 9
mark-09.question: The father prayed, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief. What is one thing you find hard to trust God with, that you will bring to him in that same prayer today?

mark-10.title: To Give His Life a Ransom for Many
mark-10.label: Mark 10
mark-10.question: Jesus asked Bartimaeus, what wilt thou that I should do unto thee? If Jesus asked you that today, what would you say?

mark-11.title: Blessed Is He That Cometh
mark-11.label: Mark 11
mark-11.question: Jesus said, when ye stand praying, forgive. Is there someone you will choose to forgive today?

mark-12.title: Thou Shalt Love the Lord Thy God
mark-12.label: Mark 12
mark-12.question: Jesus said, love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, soul, mind and strength. Which part of your life will you give to God more fully today?

mark-13.title: Take Ye Heed, Watch and Pray
mark-13.label: Mark 13
mark-13.question: Jesus said, take heed, watch and pray. What is one thing you will do today to stay awake and ready for him?

mark-14.title: Not What I Will, but What Thou Wilt
mark-14.label: Mark 14
mark-14.question: Jesus prayed, not what I will, but what thou wilt. Where in your life will you pray that same prayer today?

mark-15.title: Truly This Man Was the Son of God
mark-15.label: Mark 15
mark-15.question: Barabbas went free because Jesus took his place. What will you say to Jesus today, knowing that he took your place?

mark-16.title: He Is Risen; He Is Not Here
mark-16.label: Mark 16
mark-16.question: Now that you have walked through the whole book of Mark, who do you say Jesus is, and who will you tell about him?

walk-00.title: How to Walk Through a Chapter
walk-00.label: Start here
walk-00.question: As you begin this walk through the Bible, what do you hope to find?
